newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares rebound on secondaries buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares rebound on secondaries buying.

text.p: Jakarta share prices rebounded on Wednesday morning with fresh buying in some secondaries after three days of consolidation, brokers said.
They said sharp rises on Wall Street overnight also boosted overall market sentiment.
The Jakarta Composite Index 1.41 points, or 0.20 percent, to 696.63 points after rose to 697.67 points earlier. Gainers led losers 34 to 17, with 27 counters unchanged.
Brokers said investors seemed to be snapping up several secondaries after stock splits and bonus shares issues as well as positive predictions of better 1997 earnings.
